catalyst_rows.raw_text: Lipella Pharmaceuticals Announces Positive Final Results from Phase 2a Study of LP-10 in Oral Lichen Planus... to initiate a pivotal Phase 2b study to advance LP-10 toward registration. LP-10 (Oral Rinse) advancing toward Phase 2b IND submission.
